I need you to read back the specific account identifiers and unauthorized access flags you are seeing on your end immediately. What exact details do you have on your screen so we can lock this down?

Can you please confirm your name and extension so I can call you back through the IT security department's main line?

turns.text: Your incident reference is INC-0982-ALPHA, which is already logged in the system. As a precaution, I'd like to follow our company's standard protocol for verifying IT security requests, which involves contacting the IT department directly through our internal support channel. I'm going to go ahead and do that to ensure I'm working with the right team [WALK_AWAY]
